preconditions.description: The size of the function domain n must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value f(i) must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output k must be the minimum positive integer such that f(k)(x) is idempotent.
